claims.assertion: Yazhi says people collectively created the corrupt Federation, with some incarnating to experience it and others to repair it; she frames it as a mirror requiring individual shadow work.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says the reflection differs by person and cannot be resolved for someone else.

claims.assertion: Yazhi distinguishes a corrupt lower Federation from a non-corrupt Federation in higher planes, where the lower one is viewed as part of incarnate experience.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says the corrupt Federation receives most attention.

coverage_gaps: Yazhi’s stated need to be heard
her speculation about boredom in higher planes
